title: Heartbeat Hour Broadcast
description: A man in a white shirt and dark trousers stands center stage holding a microphone, positioned in front of a vibrant blue painted backdrop featuring a large smiling face with yellow eyes and orange mouth, black and white concentric circles, and multiple circular targets numbered 1 through 5. The entire scene is framed within a vintage television set border with text reading 'CHANNEL 12 - THE HEARTBEAT HOUR', 'LIVE', and 'ARTIST FUSION - LOGAN'.
